sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A ground phase followed by a platforming phase on floating shards, with an 11-minute enrage that doubles her damage — this is a real DPS check.

sections.heading: Defiance bar & shards
bullets: Her defiance bar activates at 90% and roughly every 60 seconds after — break it or she summons more bloodstone fragments and takes 80% reduced damage while it's up.
Bloodstone shards spawn with shields that need clearing — don't ignore them, they build up.

sections.heading: Chaos stacks & adds
bullets: Standing in the wrong place stacks Bending/Shifting/Twisting Chaos — at 10 stacks you're Overpowered, so don't let it build unchecked.
The Intervention buff protects against her deadliest attack — pay attention to when it's up.
She summons phantasms and soldiers throughout — clear them so they don't pile up during the platform phase.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 11:00 — Enraged state gives her +200% damage. Treat it as a hard DPS check.
